example:
import { EditorialSearch } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<EditorialSearch label="Card name or number" placeholder="Search a card" submitLabel="Search" action="/cards/" onSearch={(q) => navigate(q)} />
name: EditorialSearch

props.description: Site search box, or a collection's own row (visible label, live count, no button). Default: "inset".
props.name: variant

props.description: inline: live count at the end of the row.
props.name: count

props.description: Form action for the no-JS submit.
props.name: action

props.description: A scope control at the start of the box — the kit Select (borderless, width auto) with its own aria-label and name.
props.name: scope

props.description: inset (gh#1447): grouped rows { id, label, items: [{ id, href, label, description?, media?, meta? }] } under the focused box; the field becomes an ARIA combobox.
props.name: suggestions

props.description: inset: the popup's last row — all results.
props.name: suggestionsFooter

props.description: inset: accessible name of the listbox (default: label).
props.name: suggestionsLabel

props.description: inset: field text after each edit; never mid-IME-composition, once on compositionend.
props.name: onQueryChange

props.description: inset: the element suggestion rows render as (a router Link). Default "a".
props.name: linkComponent

tagline: The inset site search (gh#1435): ONE bordered box holding a search glyph, the field and the submit button, under a visually hidden label that also names the `role="search"` landmark. `onSearch` gets the trimmed query; without JavaScript the form GETs `action`. Geometry: `--editorial-search-*`.
usage: DO use it for a site search that submits; use SearchInput for a live filter.
DO use variant="inline" for a collection's own search row (visible label, live count) — gh#1439.
DO fetch suggestions yourself (debounce, abort, cache) from onQueryChange and pass the rows in; the kit neither debounces nor fetches (gh#1447).
DON'T put buttons or other controls in a suggestion row — each row is one link (role=option).
